name: Enforce Import Rules
description: Warn if any file imports from the deleted @mirage/shared package instead of the correct split packages

then.prompt: Check the file that was just saved. If it contains any import from '@mirage/shared' (not '@mirage/shared-types', '@mirage/crdt-logic', or '@mirage/ui'), flag it as a violation of the import rules in project-context.md and suggest the correct replacement import. Only report if a violation is found.
